_comment: Softlock prevention table — see Rules.py::set_rules and docs in scripts/extract_dread_rules.py::_strip_fill_fragile_items. Each entry pins behaviour at a room whose escape rule references a fill-fragile (single-pool-copy) item the strip removes. 'lock' places the item there; 'filler_only' (used when the item is already locked at another candidate room — fragile items have pool_count=1) constrains AP to non-progression items so the worst-case softlock costs at most a filler. The 12 rooms were derived from scripts/diagnose_reverse_reachability.py at trick L1; L2/L3 candidate sets are subsets. Picking the L1 escape item is conservative across tiers because tricks only add escape routes, never remove them.
